title: Weaponized Word Document Macro Spawning Encoded PowerShell

feedback.Isolate Host: CRITICAL CONTAINMENT SUCCESS: WS-HR-03 isolated via EDR. You inspected the endpoint process tree and caught WINWORD.EXE spawning cmd.exe and hidden PowerShell (MITRE T1059.001). Host isolation severed the adversary's active interactive shell before they could dump credentials or access HR salary records.
feedback.Block IP: PARTIAL MITIGATION: Blocked reverse-shell listener IP 185.190.140.33. While the outbound TCP connection was severed, the malicious PowerShell process remains active in memory on WS-HR-03 and may establish persistence via Scheduled Tasks or Registry Run keys.
feedback.Escalate: ACCEPTABLE: Escalated to Tier 2 SOC. In active interactive shell execution on an endpoint, isolating the host immediately is optimal to stop keyboard-interactive adversary intrusion.
feedback.Dismiss: CATASTROPHIC BREACH: Dismissed Word macro reverse shell as routine Office work! Adversary executed Mimikatz, dumped local LSASS secrets, and compromised HR Active Directory groups.

educational_rationale.topic: Weaponized Office Documents, VBA Macros & Child Process Execution
educational_rationale.certification_relevance: Security+ SY0-701 (Section 2.2 Malicious Code & Social Engineering, Section 4.3 Endpoint Security & EDR) & Network+ (Section 4.3 Attack Types - Reverse Shells & Non-Standard Ports)
educational_rationale.deep_dive: Microsoft Word (WINWORD.EXE) is a word processor; under normal operating conditions, it has zero legitimate reason to spawn command interpreters like cmd.exe or powershell.exe. Threat actors embed VBA macros that execute automatically upon document opening (e.g. Sub AutoOpen() or Document_Open()) using WScript.Shell.Run. Attackers pass '-ExecutionPolicy Bypass' to ignore local PowerShell execution policies, and '-WindowStyle Hidden' with '-EncodedCommand' (base64) to evade casual inspection and signature matching. Looking at parent-child process relationships (PPID -> PID) in EDR or Sysmon Event ID 1 is one of the highest-fidelity detection heuristics in modern security operations.
